commit.message:
Replace xml-patch with a custom implementation

xml-patch introduces a few common security risks often present when
handling XML. Worse, the library provides no mechanism to provide a
secure implementation. Fixing this with internal Java XML libraries is
under 600 LOC, so it's implemented here instead.
